stories.title: November 2026 Patch Tuesday: 63 Critical Microsoft fixes, plus an Outlook zero day that allows theft of hashed credentials
stories.why: A currently exploited zero-day vulnerability that can let attackers steal hashed Outlook NTLM credentials is among the 1,094 holes Microsoft fixed in its November Patch Tuesday releases.

stories.why: Microsoft researchers have found that rewriting fewer than 10 rarely used neurons in an open-weight AI model can turn any agent built on it into a sleeper backdoor that runs an attacker’s commands on cue, with no…

stories.title: SGLang RCE Exploit Breaches NEAR AI, Steals Data From 18 Agents and About 100 Users
stories.why: An attacker exploited a remote code execution flaw in SGLang, an open-source inference engine, and ran code on one of NEAR AI's inference servers last Sunday.

stories.title: Microsoft researchers demonstrate hidden backdoor technique for AI agents
stories.why: Microsoft researchers have demonstrated how small changes to an AI model can implant a hidden backdoor, causing an agent to execute an attacker’s command when a specific trigger appears.

stories.title: AI company Fireworks says hackers stole data, billing info during October breaches
stories.why: Fireworks said the incident affected a “limited number of customer accounts” — all of whom were notified of the attack.

stories.title: Artex: The AI Pen-Test Tool Hackers Turned Into a Weapon
stories.why: Forks of the open source Artex framework, along with 45 similar pen-testing tools, remain capable of executing credential attacks and cloud breaches at machine speed across multiple industries.

stories.title: Microsoft Researchers Show AI Agents Can Be Backdoored by Editing Fewer Than 10 Neurons
stories.why: An AI model can be given a hidden backdoor by editing fewer than 10 of its rarely used neurons, without retraining the model, Microsoft researchers have shown.
